svg.title: FastVM: from idle to awake
svg.desc: On a Linux host, an incoming packet enters the virtual NIC queue and FastVM signals Cloud Hypervisor to resume the paused guest. In deep sleep, the guest reads pages it touches from a disk-backed memory snapshot. The queued request can then reach the guest service. Solid, dashed and dotted traces distinguish packet, resume signal and memory reads.
svg.text: How the first request wakes a microVM
Linux host · Cloud Hypervisor and KVM
